name: topstep_mcp
summary: TopstepX futures connector wrapping the existing standalone scalper at /data/Projects/trade-blob/ via subprocess against a cross-repo shim (scripts/tsx_cli.py). HARD SAFETY RAIL: every write tool (order_market, order_limit, flatten_all) DEFAULTS to DRY-RUN and only fires a real order when BOTH `confirm=True` is passed in args AND `TOPSTEP_LIVE_TRADING=1` is set in the environment. Either gate alone returns a safe stub with `dry_run: True`, a `fake_order_id`, and a `would_have_ordered` descriptor. Every call (real or DRY-RUN) crystal-anchors via inference_logger with tier='trade_action', model='topstepx', scope='topstep_<tool>'.
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass mirroring stripe_mcp shape. SERVICE='topstep'. Reads TOPSTEP_USERNAME + TOPSTEP_API_KEY from /data/Projects/trade-blob/.env via a tiny dedicated env reader (does NOT route through studio/auth/keys.upstream_key because 'topstep' may not be in KINDS yet). Subprocess against trade-blob's venv python when present, falls back to system python3. Tool dispatch via send(recipient=tool_name, message=json_args).

safety_rails.gate_logic: real order fires iff confirm=True in args AND TOPSTEP_LIVE_TRADING=1 in env. Either missing => DRY-RUN stub returned with dry_run=True, fake_order_id, and would_have_ordered descriptor.
safety_rails.flatten_all_note: nuclear close-everything button. Same double-gate; no special override path. Treated identically to a normal write tool.
safety_rails.cancel_order_classification: safe (no new exposure). Routed through read-tool path; no live-gate required. Still requires tsx_cli.py to exist for execution.
safety_rails.stub_behavior_when_shim_missing: read tools (account_status, positions, health_check, quote_subscribe, pnl_intraday) return stubs marked stub=True so dashboards do not crash. Write tools return SendResult(success=False, error='tsx_cli_not_found: ...') ONLY when both confirm and live env are set; otherwise the DRY-RUN path is taken first and the shim is never consulted.
safety_rails.credential_leakage_protection: TOPSTEP_USERNAME and TOPSTEP_API_KEY are loaded from disk into memory only. They are injected into the subprocess env explicitly. They are stripped from any params dict before being passed to inference_logger.log so the crystal chain never embeds them.

tsx_cli_status.blocker: live trading cannot fire until this shim is created in the trade-blob repo. The shim must accept positional `tool` arg + `--json <args>` and emit a single JSON object on stdout. Read-only tools fall back to stubs so dashboards keep working without it.
tsx_cli_status.remediation: create /data/Projects/trade-blob/scripts/tsx_cli.py as a thin wrapper around the existing TopstepXClient in trade-blob/topstep_api/*. Must read TOPSTEP_USERNAME and TOPSTEP_API_KEY from process env (injected by this connector). Out of scope for MySpace++ side per constraints.

env_vars.TOPSTEP_LIVE_TRADING: set to '1' to lift one of two gates required for live orders; default unset = DRY-RUN forever

convenience_wrappers: order_market(symbol, qty, side, confirm=False) -> DRY-RUN unless confirm AND live env
order_limit(symbol, qty, side, price, confirm=False) -> DRY-RUN unless confirm AND live env
flatten_all(confirm=False) -> nuclear close-all; same double-gate as order_market
substrate: /data/Projects/trade-blob/ (READ-ONLY from this connector's POV; subprocess only) + ~/.cc/third_party_logs/topstep_sends.jsonl (history) + ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl (crystal-anchored trade_action records) + ~/.cc/topstep_quotes/<symbol>.jsonl (quote_subscribe sinks)

routing_connections.substrate_reads: TOPSTEP_USERNAME + TOPSTEP_API_KEY from /data/Projects/trade-blob/.env (direct read, bypasses studio/auth/keys because 'topstep' is not yet in KINDS)
routing_connections.substrate_writes: send_log JSONL + crystal_chain trade_action records + quote_subscribe sink files

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.order_market_dry_run_default: ok - dry_run=True, fake_order_id returned, no shim consulted
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.order_market_confirm_without_live_env: ok - dry_run=True (live env gate held the line)
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.account_status_with_no_shim: returns stub payload, success=True, stub=True, no dashboard crash
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.law_verified: DRY-RUN is the default under all observed conditions

guarantees: DRY-RUN by default - real orders require BOTH confirm=True AND TOPSTEP_LIVE_TRADING=1
Crystal-anchored - every call (DRY-RUN included) writes one InferenceRecord with tier='trade_action'
Stdlib-only - no pip packages; subprocess + urllib + json + uuid + pathlib only
Credential-safe - TOPSTEP_API_KEY never appears in stdout, crystal logs, or send logs
Graceful - when tsx_cli.py is missing, read tools return stubs marked stub=True; write tools never silently succeed
Read-only of trade-blob - this connector never edits the trade-blob repo; only subprocess + .env read
usage_example:
from core.lib.third_party.topstep_mcp import TopStepMCPConnector
import json
c = TopStepMCPConnector()
c.connect()
# DRY-RUN by default:
r = c.send('order_market', json.dumps({'symbol':'ES','qty':1,'side':'BUY'}))
assert r.metadata['dry_run'] is True
# Even with confirm=True, no real order unless TOPSTEP_LIVE_TRADING=1 in env:
r2 = c.send('order_market', json.dumps({'symbol':'ES','qty':1,'side':'BUY','confirm':True}))
assert r2.metadata['dry_run'] is True  # because env gate not lifted
